findings.current: “The three of us used to stop by this place from time to time. That was more than thirty years ago. Your Master wasn’t the Sect Leader back then, either.”
findings.defect: The translation omits that the three men were martial brothers, losing an explicit relationship that establishes their shared hierarchy and history.
findings.rationale: 세 사형제 explicitly identifies the three as martial brothers, not merely three unspecified companions.
findings.replacement: “We three martial brothers used to stop by this place from time to time. That was more than thirty years ago. Your Master wasn’t the Sect Leader back then, either.”
findings.source: “우리 세 사형제는 종종 이곳에 들르고는 했다. 삼십 년도 더 전의 일이지. 그때는 네 사부도 장문인이 아니었고.”

findings.current: He had kept his mouth shut for more than an hour while waiting for the old man to finish preparing his tea, and his voice was cracked like a drought-stricken rice paddy.
findings.defect: The draft more than doubles the stated duration and adds that he was waiting for the old man to finish, which the source does not say.
findings.rationale: 한 식경 is approximately half an hour in this genre, while the source says he waited through the old man’s tea art rather than specifically waiting for its completion.
findings.replacement: He had kept his mouth shut for more than half an hour while the old man performed his tea ceremony, and his voice was cracked like a drought-stricken rice paddy.
findings.source: 한 식경이 넘도록 입을 다물고 노인의 다예(茶艺)를 기다린 그의 목소리는 가뭄의 논바닥처럼 쩍쩍 갈라져 있었다.

findings.current: Huashan and Zhongnan, the two dragons and tigers entrenched in Shaanxi Province, held a gathering once every ten years, where their young prodigies competed against one another.
findings.defect: “The two dragons and tigers” is an unnatural and numerically ambiguous rendering of the paired dragon-and-tiger metaphor.
findings.rationale: 두 마리의 용과 호랑이 presents the two sects as the province’s paired dragon and tiger.
findings.replacement: Huashan and Zhongnan—the dragon and tiger crouched in Shaanxi Province—held a gathering once every ten years where their young prodigies competed against one another.
findings.source: 섬서성에 웅크린 두 마리의 용과 호랑이, 화산과 종남은 십 년에 한 번 모임을 가져 자파의 후기지수들을 겨루게 했다.

findings.current: Even though his only Senior Brother was lying unconscious with an Internal Injury, Hwangbo Eom continued to hurl abuse at him.
findings.defect: The draft adds that Song Il is unconscious. The source only says that he is laid up or has collapsed after suffering an Internal Injury.
findings.rationale: 쓰러져 있음 does not establish unconsciousness, so the draft changes Song Il’s physical condition.
findings.replacement: Even though his only Senior Brother was laid up with an Internal Injury, Hwangbo Eom continued to spew venom at him.
findings.source: 하나뿐인 사형이 내상을 입고 쓰러져 있음에도 독설을 퍼붓는 황보엄의 모습에 혁소평과 태을검대 제자들은 다시 한번 깨달았다.

findings.current: Neither of them could match his martial arts or his poisonous heart.
findings.defect: “Poisonous heart” is an unnatural literalism that can be mistaken for a physical or technique-related concept rather than ruthless character.
findings.rationale: 독심 here describes Hwangbo Eom’s ruthless, hard-hearted disposition.
findings.replacement: Neither of them could match his martial prowess or his ruthlessness.
findings.source: 두 사람 중 누구도 자신의 무공과 독심(毒心)을 따라올 수 없었으니까.

findings.current: While you were lost in despair and wasting your days on wine, women, and idle amusements, this old man was working to restore our sect.
findings.defect: The draft dilutes 잡기 into generic idle amusements and omits the gambling component of the conventional vice list.
findings.rationale: 주색잡기 is a condemnatory list of debauchery—drinking, women, and gambling—not merely harmless leisure.
findings.replacement: While you were lost in despair and wasting your days on drinking, women, and gambling, this old man was working to restore our sect.
findings.source: 네놈이 실의에 빠져 주색잡기나 하는 동안, 노부는 사문을 일으키기 위해 힘쓰고 있었느니라.

findings.current: “Good. Did you bring the item you commissioned?”
findings.defect: The draft reverses who commissioned or requested the item, making Ju Hwaran the client instead of Hwangbo Eom.
findings.rationale: Hwangbo Eom is asking whether Ju Hwaran brought the item from the commission he issued.
findings.replacement: “Good. Did you safely bring the item I requested?”

findings.current: The Swift Wind Sword answered gruffly.
findings.defect: The draft identifies Hyuk Mujin as the respondent, but the answering character is Gung Gibang, whom Taekyung immediately addresses as Gibang.
findings.rationale: The source’s joking nickname refers to Gung Gibang; “Swift Wind Sword” is Hyuk Mujin’s established epithet and changes the speaker’s identity.

findings.current: I’d bet Hyuk Mujin’s wrist that he wasn’t some kindly old man who chuckled warmly at the neighborhood children. If that wasn’t enough, I’d bet his ankle too.
findings.defect: The draft invents neighborhood children as the objects of the old man’s warmth.
findings.rationale: The source only invokes the image of a chuckling neighborhood grandfather; it does not mention children.
findings.replacement: I’d bet Hyuk Mujin’s wrist that he wasn’t some genial, chuckling neighborhood grandpa. If that wasn’t enough, I’d bet his ankle too.
findings.source: 허허 웃는 동네 할아버지는 아니라는 것에 혁무진의 손모가지를 걸 수도 있다. 부족하다면 발모가지도.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin asked with a wary expression.
findings.defect: The draft reverses Hyuk Mujin’s pragmatic cue: he looks hopeful that he may finally be allowed to voice his complaint, not wary.
findings.rationale: 혹시나 하는 얼굴 conveys tentative hope or expectation in response to Taekyung asking whether he has a complaint.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin asked with a hopeful look.

findings.current:
*Nothing will happen.*

I muttered softly and threw open the door.
findings.defect: The line is formatted as an internal thought even though the source and the following narration explicitly present it as something Taekyung mutters aloud.
findings.rationale: 중얼거린 marks quiet speech, so the line should use dialogue quotation marks rather than thought italics.
findings.replacement: “Nothing will happen,” I muttered softly, then threw open the door.
findings.source:
별일 없을 겁니다.

작게 중얼거린 나는 문을 열어젖혔다.

summary: The draft contains several fidelity errors, including a reversed commission, a misidentified speaker, an altered duration, and an unsupported claim that Song Il is unconscious. It also loses martial kinship, gambling, and two pragmatic cues.
